round_interpretation: Round one increased hypervolume by 15.49%. MOVE removal improved all three objectives in the risk-state parent; VIX slope-change removal increased IC/NLL, while oil and local volatility generated alternative tradeoffs. The broad high-Sharpe model benefited from removing HY change but was harmed by removing the gold/oil ratio. Combine successful risk removals and selected transfers, distinguish FX and risk-state contributions, and prune remaining credit axes in the broad model. Do not assume oil-only or one shared local basis wins in every context.
default_expected_tradeoff: Compare three-objective results and paired seed dispersion; report uncertainty calibration alongside width without using width as an objective.
default_falsification: A dominated result rejects the proposed conditional improvement; a new tradeoff remains eligible. Broad and compact models are alternative representations, not a reason to silently weight NLL against IC/Sharpe.
